ai.summary: The page https://www.ifaw.org/ loaded in the headless browser with HTTP 200 and no load error. The FundraiseUp installation code for account AWMWZJRX is in the page source, and the widget script loaded at runtime from cdn.fundraiseup.com with HTTP 200. The verdict is ready with warnings and no blockers. The browser did not click any buttons, so it did not test whether checkout works. It found one donate link to the checkout form (?form=join), and that link returns donation content in the HTML without JavaScript. The code sits in the head, but 3 script tags follow it. Usercentrics sits in the call stack that inserted the widget script, so visitors who decline cookies may not get the widget unless it is set as strictly necessary. The page load event took 8.9 seconds. No GA4 measurement ID was seen loading or sending hits, which may be because it loads only after consent. The Meta Pixel was not seen, and it is optional.

next_steps.action: Ask your web developer to move the FundraiseUp code so it is the last script in the head, after the other three script tags.

customer_email.subject: Three quick fixes for your donation widget on ifaw.org
customer_email.body:
Hello,

Thank you for working with us to launch donations on your website. Your FundraiseUp donation widget is installed and loads on https://www.ifaw.org/. Before launch, please make these three changes.

1. Move the FundraiseUp code so it is the last script in the page head. Right now, three other scripts load after it.

2. Ask your web developer or consent tool administrator to set the FundraiseUp widget as strictly necessary in Usercentrics. This makes sure visitors who decline cookies still see the donation widget.

3. Let us know whether you use a Google Analytics 4 property, so we can confirm it is set up on the page.

After you make these changes, reply to this email and we will run the check again.

Thank you,
The Onboarding Team
